minimal_coherence_module.boundary_requirement: partial(H_g)=delta_g for every labelled germ g
minimal_coherence_module.equivariant_requirement: sigma(H_g)=H_sigma(g) and partial commutes with sigma

rank_distinction.warning: do not identify the rank-two cohomological excess per germ with two independent homotopy cells

local_to_global_falsifier: a single source-labelled cell construction plus labelled branch and cyclic naturality is sufficient; if its boundary is nonzero scalar times delta, normalization is fixed by the source orientation rather than fitted afterward
scope: necessary global equivariant typing; it does not construct the local cell or prove regulator-chamber uniqueness
